limitations: CP-0007 proves the preserved CP-0004 handshake, CP-0005 queue control, and CP-0006 bridge-private functional memory path plus bounded signal lifecycle and event completion. It implements no KFD event handle, GPU-visible signal memory, packet-visible VRAM, SDMA timing, packet submission, code-object loading, kernel execution, collective, HIP, HSA, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, or vLLM inference path.
SIGNAL_COMPLETION one-tick relationships are gem5 event-queue semantics and are not GPU dispatch or kernel timing evidence.

The real-process signal gate covers one signed timeout/store-triggered wait, retry without resend, load/destroy, and deterministic slot reuse; it does not prove concurrent multi-signal workloads or cross-rank signal sharing.
N=1/2/3/4/8 validates independent daemon identity and topology routing, not cross-rank memory, tensor-parallel collectives, or simulated GPU work.
Build trees, binaries, caches, signal payloads, and raw process logs remain ignored external artifacts and are not committed.
